en: The postcard features a picturesque old European street scene. The road is narrow and curved with stone buildings lining both sides, and a tall medieval-looking tower with a red-tiled roof is prominent in the background. The buildings have steep red rooftops and numerous chimneys. Two figures dressed in early 20th-century attire are walking down the street. The style of architecture and general ambiance strongly suggest a historical part of a central or eastern European city.
